tool: Normal Chrome via cua_repl; public product page and expanded supplier description
scope: Five representative pages, four suppliers; observed text and page declarations, not verified product performance or whole-industry sales ranking
method_location: 02_Alibaba运营/00_运营SOP/国际站商品全生命周期SOP.md §6.1

rows.observation: Original-style MOQ 2 pairs; separate packaging option MOQ 300 pairs. Expanded descIframe visible FAQ covers company identity, quality steps, products, supplier differentiation and service terms. Header model 1078/microfiber differs from body model 2310L/mesh.
rows.adopt: Separate stock-style and service thresholds; direct answers where known.
rows.improve: Avoid generic company FAQ on every style and stale model/material template text.

rows.observation: MOQ 300 pairs, sample offer separately priced. Expanded descIframe company FAQ uses the same general company/quality/product/service subjects as the other sampled Kaisun style.
rows.improve: Supply shoe-specific fit, size and order answers instead of repeating general company history.

rows.supplier: Xiamen Golden Heymann Import & Export Co., Ltd.
rows.observation: Visible highlights grouped by upper, midsole, outsole, insole and OEM/ODM. FAQ covers custom samples, lead-time trigger, colorway quantity, existing versus new sole molds, bulk sequence. Header quantity tier begins at 500 pairs while FAQ describes standard MOQ 1000 pairs without a clear distinction.
rows.adopt: Explain development inputs and the decision between existing molds and new tooling.
rows.improve: Anchor highlights to the exact shoe rather than claiming every material choice and universal performance; clarify commercial conditions.

rows.supplier: Dongguan Ai Mei Cheng Shoes Co., Ltd.
rows.observation: Visible highlights connect knit, cross-straps and EVA sole to wearer use; FAQ asks for sample BOM/drawings, addresses logo, packaging, MOQ and production/shipping. Test answer promises orders will pass tests, a supplier declaration rather than evidence.
rows.adopt: Feature-to-value connections and specific design inputs.
rows.improve: Do not transplant tested performance, guaranteed test passage or fixed times to Beiqiang.

rows.observation: Public page displays #6 leading manufacturer in Sports & Outdoor Shoes and #1 hot-selling in Fitness & Cross-training Shoes. At-a-glance structure summary is distinct from the supplier description. Expanded visible description FAQ distinguishes original versus logo/custom samples, logo AI artwork, packaging and order steps. Header MOQ 2 pairs and custom MOQ 500 pairs are separate fields.
rows.adopt: Answer by order type and explain the exact artwork/packing inputs.
rows.improve: Page-specific category ranks are not a whole-industry ranking; platform summaries and medical/thickness claims are not Beiqiang facts.

conclusion: Use exact-shoe selection value for highlights and answer-first procurement questions for FAQ. Retain relevant order conditions once. Competitor figures and capability declarations are not transferred. No copied FAQ or duplicated permanent method.
